text:
maya: Heads-up from VoiceOver testing: collapsed tool-call entries create extra tab stops. Two fixes: make every call label tabbable, or add a single skiplink like "Jump to latest" + aria-live announcements. Opinions?

jesse: Skiplink + aria-live for me. Cleaner keyboard flow. Make skiplink visible when focused so it's discoverable.

samir: Agree. Implementation notes: target element needs tabindex='-1' so we can programmatically focus it. Add role="region" and aria-live="polite" on the run container. For collapsed stacks, expose a short sr-only summary (e.g., "4 calls, newest: SummarizeText - success") to avoid extra focusable nodes.

ellen: Copy: use concise label "Jump to latest". For the action button, prefer "Run tool" over just "Run" to give context inside the structured-output panel. I'll draft the tooltip copy.

maya: Can someone spin up a tiny Storybook story with the skiplink + aria-live and tag a11y? I'll test on mac VoiceOver.

a11y-bot: Accessibility check placed: 2024-04-03 10:00 PT. Invite sent to maya, samir, ellen, jesse. Reminder 30m prior.

jesse: I'll open the PR with the prototype and include the focus/fallback checklist. Will post the link here when ready.

maya: Thanks — excited to test.
